decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.896. Series context: trend strength 0.8565 and seasonal strength 0.2762; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.088); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.29.
